name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
description: Flagship skill development program providing industry-relevant technical and vocational training with government certification, stipends, and placement support.
benefits: Free certification, NSQF-aligned training, DBT stipend, placement assistance, 3-year accidental insurance.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
description: Comprehensive health insurance offering ₹5 Lakh cashless coverage per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization across empaneled hospitals.
benefits: ₹5,00,000 cashless annual medical treatment per family, covers pre-existing diseases, over 1900 medical procedures.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 to all landholding farmer families across India.
benefits: ₹6,000 direct bank transfer per year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
description: Collateral-free working capital micro-loans starting from ₹10,000 up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy for street vendors and hawkers.
benefits: Collateral-free loans (₹10k, ₹20k, ₹50k), 7% interest subsidy, up to ₹1,200 annual digital cashback.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Collateral-free business loans up to ₹10 Lakh (Shishu, Kishore, Tarun) to support non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises.
benefits: Collateral-free loans up to ₹50k (Shishu), up to ₹5 Lakh (Kishore), up to ₹10-20 Lakh (Tarun).

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: Government-backed high-interest savings scheme for girl children up to 10 years of age with EEE tax exemption under Beti Bachao Beti Padhao.
benefits: High guaranteed interest (~8.2% p.a.), Section 80C tax exemption, maturity at 21 years or marriage after 18.

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS-2)
description: On-the-job industrial apprenticeship training with government stipend sharing (25% up to ₹1,500/month DBT) and recognized certification.
benefits: Industry work experience, 25% stipend support up to ₹1,500/month DBT, National Apprenticeship Certificate.
